name: search_papers
description: Search academic papers by keyword, author, or topic using the Semantic Scholar API

query.description: Search query (keywords, paper title, or topic)

max_results.description: Maximum number of results to return

name: fetch_abstract
description: Retrieve the abstract and metadata for a specific paper by its identifier

paper_id.description: Paper identifier (DOI, Semantic Scholar ID, or arXiv ID)

include_references.description: Whether to include the paper's reference list

name: file_write
description: Write content to a file in the output directory

path.description: Relative file path within the allowed output directory

content.description: Content to write to the file

name: json_parse
description: Parse a JSON string and extract a value at a given path

path.description: Dot-notation path to extract (e.g. 'results.0.title'). Omit to return the full parsed object.
